findings.title: Indian certification authority eMudhra’s private keys compromised – one of them was the number ‘4’
findings.summary_md: The Register reports that Indian CA eMudhra’s private keys for intermediate certificates were compromised due to a Key Generation Ceremony flaw. The article notes one private key was literally the number “4” and describes a massive clean-up effort, stating the breach makes it possible to impersonate any website or service. Published 20 October 2026.
